title: Desert Tracks ABC
hook: Read the sand, then let the wind erase the trail.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: sunny 3D desert storybook, sand gold and sky blue, friendly wildlife, soft cactus shapes, crisp isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading desert signs from a safe distance and distinguishing moving traces from stationary landmarks
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: return to print-trace-landmark and the idea that wind eventually erases signs
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: dry 4/4 walking pulse with footprint rests
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written trace observations; animal tracks, plant forms and rock markers are clearly different kinds of clues
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: track or landmark cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe point/trace gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the desert readable through traces: pawprints, hoof marks, tail lines, bird steps, wind-shaped sand and stationary plant or rock landmarks tell a story without claiming every target leaves a track.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads signs left on open ground; recurring language uses print, trace, line, mark, crossing, fade, still marker and wind-erased.
semanticArc: plants and rocks become fixed landmarks
wind softens every trace by evening
forbiddenGenericLanguage: desert friends walk on with me
